sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: European larch is a deciduous conifer native to the mountains of central Europe. It usually grows 15–22 m tall and 7–10 m wide.

sections.title: Needles and cones
sections.text: Its soft, 2.5–3.5 cm needles grow in clusters on short shoots, then turn yellow and fall in autumn. The upright female cones are about 2.5–4 cm long.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: Its durable timber is used in construction. The cited sources do not document a food use for this species.
